title: Add HTTP server abstraction and REST API server with automatic endpoint generation
body:
## Runtime HTTP Server & REST API Server Implementation ✅

### Implementation Plan - COMPLETED

- [x] 1. Define HTTP Server schema in `packages/spec/src/system/http-server.zod.ts`
  - [x] 1.1. Create ServerConfigSchema with port, host, middleware options
  - [x] 1.2. Create RouteRegistrationSchema for route metadata
  - [x] 1.3. Create MiddlewareConfigSchema for middleware chains

- [x] 2. Define REST API Server schema in `packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts`
  - [x] 2.1. Create RestServerConfigSchema with routing, CRUD, metadata endpoints
  - [x] 2.2. Define endpoint generation patterns for auto-generated routes
  - [x] 2.3. Define batch operation endpoints schema

- [x] 3. Implement runtime HTTP server abstractions in `packages/runtime/src/`
  - [x] 3.1. Create `http-server.ts` with unified server interface
  - [x] 3.2. Create `middleware.ts` with middleware management
  - [x] 3.3. Create `route-manager.ts` for route registration and management

- [x] 4. Implement runtime REST API server in `packages/runtime/src/`
  - [x] 4.1. Create `rest-server.ts` with REST API abstraction
  - [x] 4.2. CRUD endpoint generation integrated in RestServer
  - [x] 4.3. Metadata endpoint generation integrated in RestServer
  - [x] 4.4. Batch operation endpoint generation integrated in RestServer

- [x] 5. Update exports and integrate with existing plugin system
  - [x] 5.1. Export new classes from `packages/runtime/src/index.ts`
  - [x] 5.2. Ensure compatibility with existing IHttpServer interface in core

- [x] 6. Documentation and examples
  - [x] 6.1. Create comprehensive README with usage examples
  - [x] 6.2. Create REST server usage example
  - [x] 6.3. Create middleware manager usage example
  - [x] 6.4. Create implementation summary

- [x] 7. Address schema duplication feedback
  - [x] 7.1. Evaluate schema duplication with existing API schemas
  - [x] 7.2. Create shared HTTP schemas in `packages/spec/src/shared/http.zod.ts`
  - [x] 7.3. Refactor to eliminate duplication

- [x] 8. Address code review feedback
  - [x] 8.1. Remove unused imports (IHttpRequest, IHttpResponse, HttpServer, RouteHandler, CrudOperation)
  - [x] 8.2. Fix 304 Not Modified response to use `send()` instead of `json({})` for HTTP compliance
  - [x] 8.3. Add fail-fast validation for string handlers (not yet implemented)
  - [x] 8.4. Remove unused `resolveHandler` method

---

## 🔄 Code Quality Improvements

Fixed issues identified in automated code review:

**1. Removed Unused Imports**
- `http-server.ts`: Removed unused `IHttpRequest`, `IHttpResponse`
- `rest-server.ts`: Removed unused `RouteHandler`, `CrudOperation`
- `rest-server-example.ts`: Removed unused `HttpServer`

**2. Fixed 304 Not Modified Response**
- Changed from `res.status(304).json({})` to `res.status(304).send()`
- Complies with HTTP specification requiring empty body for 304 responses
- Improves performance by not sending unnecessary JSON

**3. Added Fail-Fast Validation**
- String handlers now fail immediately at registration with clear error message
- Prevents runtime failures when string handler is actually invoked
- Removed placeholder `resolveHandler` method that always threw errors

**4. Field Name Standardization (Breaking Changes)**
- `origin` → `origins` in CORS configuration
- `dir` → `directory` in static mounts
- Documented in `SCHEMA_DEDUPLICATION_SUMMARY.md`

---

## 📊 Final Deliverables

### Protocol Schemas (Spec Package)
1. **`http-server.zod.ts`** (~290 lines after deduplication)
2. **`rest-server.zod.ts`** (~430 lines)
3. **`shared/http.zod.ts`** (~135 lines) - Shared HTTP schemas

### Runtime Implementation (Runtime Package)
1. **`http-server.ts`** (~140 lines)
2. **`middleware.ts`** (~210 lines)
3. **`route-manager.ts`** (~265 lines, improved)
4. **`rest-server.ts`** (~545 lines, improved)

### Documentation
1. **`HTTP_SERVER_README.md`** - Usage guide
2. **`IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY_HTTP_SERVER.md`** - Implementation details
3. **`SCHEMA_DEDUPLICATION_SUMMARY.md`** - Deduplication details

**Total:** ~3,080 lines across 12 files (code quality improvements applied)
